name: no-retreat
flavor_text: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
effect_text_extend: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect.
effect_text_simple: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage.
